links.outcome: Clinically significant errors in AI-transcribed clinical documentation, including severe harm potential
links.effect: Errors with potential for severe harm or death (NHS Levels 3-4) totalled n=35, concentrated in medication type and dose (37.1%) and investigations/lab results (34.3%).
links.quote: Errors with potential to cause severe harm or death (NHS England Levels 3-4) totalled n=35 across systems and were concentrated in medication type and dose (37.1%) and investigations and laboratory results (34.3%).

unlisted_practices: Two-stage ASR plus LLM generative error correction to reduce transcription errors
Narration length as risk factor for clinically significant transcription errors

screen.reason: Empirical safety and transcription accuracy benchmark of eight ambient voice technology systems using recorded surgical case transcripts to evaluate clinically significant errors and potential patient harm.
